reviews.text: I bought Royal Honey cream for the first time. It's very convenient that it comes in a tube. You can squeeze out the required amount and it doesn't come into contact with other objects. It moisturizes well, so I use it as a morning and evening skincare product. It absorbs fairly quickly and doesn't leave a heavy or sticky feeling.
reviews.zh: 我第一次買 Royal Honey 面霜。佢用軟管裝，非常方便，可以擠出所需份量，亦唔會碰到其他物件。保濕效果好好，所以我早晚都用嚟做護膚。吸收幾快，唔會有厚重或者黏膩嘅感覺。

reviews.text: Very soft, but a thicker formula for a day cream so it makes application a little slow. It also takes a bit too long to absorb in so when I want to start my makeup it is delayed. It does feel nice on the skin and keeps me moist, though.
reviews.zh: 質地好柔軟，但作為日霜嚟講配方偏厚，所以塗抹就慢少少。吸收時間都長咗少少，所以想開始化妝嗰陣就會延誤。不過，塗落皮膚嘅感覺好好，亦都可以令我保持濕潤。

reviews.text: It is a lightweight, hydrating moisturizer made with honey extract and royal jelly. It feels fresh on the skin but provides long-lasting moisture, making it great for daily use on normal to combination or dehydrated skin. The formula is clean—free of silicones, artificial fragrance, and colorants—so it’s gentle and suitable for sensitive skin. Users love its soft texture and glow-boosting effect, though it may feel a bit light in very dry or cold climates.
reviews.zh: 呢款係輕盈嘅保濕面霜，由蜂蜜萃取物同蜂王乳製成。塗落皮膚有清新感，但保濕效果持久，好適合日常用喺中性、混合性或者缺水皮膚。配方好乾淨，唔含矽靈、人工香料同色素，所以溫和，亦適合敏感皮膚。用家都好鍾意佢嘅柔軟質感同提亮光澤效果，不過喺非常乾燥或寒冷嘅氣候入面，可能會覺得有啲輕薄。

reviews.text: PLEASE KEEP THIS IN STOCK! this is the only thing that works for my dry sensitive skin. It is a thin consistency but becomes tacky after a while. An amazing base for makeup. And also amazing for my everyday
reviews.zh: 求你哋一定要有貨！呢個係唯一對我乾性敏感肌有效嘅產品。佢質地偏稀，但過一陣就會有啲黏。係好好嘅化妝打底。日常用都非常好。

reviews.text:
My holy grail moisturizer all year around!!! This is my absolute favorite. I cannot live without this moisturizer. Please continue to make this Skin Food.

Very moisturizing, absorbs quickly, and super light. Works well under make up too! I love putting this moisturizer on top of my evening prescription Trenton gel and does not irritate! Skin is comfortable and non greasy
reviews.zh:
我一年四季都愛用嘅心水之選！！！呢款絕對係我最愛。冇咗佢我真係生存唔到。請你哋繼續生產呢款 Skin Food。

非常保濕，吸收快，而且超輕盈。化妝底下用都好好！我好鍾意喺晚上塗完我嘅處方 Trenton 啫喱之後，再塗呢款面霜，佢唔會刺激！皮膚感覺舒適，唔油膩。

reviews.text: I'm a huge fan of the Royal Honey Moisture Toner so I wanted to try other products in the series. I didn't like this one as much - it's moisturising but I feel like it's clogging me up and causing me minor breakouts.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意 Royal Honey 保濕爽膚水，所以想試吓系列入面嘅其他產品。我冇咁鍾意呢款，佢雖然有保濕，但我覺得佢令我毛孔阻塞，仲導致我有少少暗瘡。

reviews.text:
my go to cream for the dry windy winters because
nothing works quite as this one to top my other products or even alone under spf. consider it if your skin tends to get cut or flaky because of the cold and wind.
very lightweight so it is good even for oily skin. or for men. but i would avoid it during rainy months or when exercising.
reviews.zh:
乾燥多風嘅冬天，我最常用嘅面霜，因為冇其他產品效果可以好似呢款咁好，可以疊喺其他產品上面，或者單獨喺防曬底下用都好啱。如果你嘅皮膚因為寒冷同大風容易起裂或者脫皮，可以考慮吓。
好輕盈，所以連油性皮膚都適合。或者男士都適用。不過，我會避免喺下雨嘅月份或者運動嗰陣用。
